title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p6n9: Python EDHOC TH_2 CBOR encoding breaks interop with Rust test vectors
description:
## Bug

`python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py` changed TH_2 encoding from raw byte concatenation to CBOR encoding:

Initiator (line 389): `cbor2.dumps(g_y) + cbor2.dumps(h_msg1)`  
Responder (line 598): `cbor2.dumps(self._eph_pk) + cbor2.dumps(h_msg1)`

Previously raw: `g_y + h_msg1`

The Rust implementation in `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:407-414` uses raw concatenation (`G_Y || H(msg1)`) and its test vector (`rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors`) matches RFC 9529 Appendix B. The Python CBOR change will produce different TH_2 values, breaking interop between implementations.

The Python code should revert to raw concatenation to match Rust and the RFC 9529 test vectors.
